associations.rationale: The result produces parameters and a nonempty ToFamEquiv, but that custom type is opaque in the displayed evidence, so the claimed isomorphism classification is not directly stated there.

The formal type states that the generic carrier Fin p to k has finrank p, but it does not itself identify that carrier with the parameterized modules V(alpha,c), so it only supports their p-dimensionality.

The formal type asserts irreducibility of the parameterized family, but it does not itself state its p-dimensionality or the classification of all finite-dimensional irreducibles, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
